name: model-companion-web
description: Shared model companion components with Inochi2D and VRM WebGL2 backends

scripts.build: npm run fixtures && npm run build:wasm && npm run build --workspace model-widget-core && npm run build --workspace inochi2d-web && npm run build --workspace vrm-web && npm run build --workspace hexo-model-companion && npm run build --workspace @inochi2d-web/vanilla-example && npm run build --workspace @inochi2d-web/hexo-example && npm run build --workspace @inochi2d-web/hexo-vrm-example
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.pack:release-check: npm run check:licenses && INOCHI2D_RELEASE_PACK=1 node tools/verify-package-contents.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run check:rust && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:runtime-budget && npm run check:licenses && npm run test && npm run pack:check
